items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Beauford, he was one of the great solo tuba players around Chicago.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was one. And...(another) he made some records in my place with Jelly Roll -- Beauford. Beauford, he was one of the great solo tuba players around Chicago. We had several. In fact, most of the tuba players around Chicago could play solos.
What were some of the solos that they played?
